serpStructure.note: Based on WebSearch snippets only (WebFetch blocked), so word counts are estimates. SERP is thin: most results are drilled wall/post-mounted boxes, not renter locks; no results address adhesive or no-drill mounting directly. Rules found: on USPS-owned cluster boxes the lock belongs to USPS, do not drill or swap it, contact the local postmaster; on landlord/HOA-owned boxes management is responsible for locks and keys and approval is needed; tampering with another person's mail is a crime (18 U.S.C. 1702); carriers may refuse delivery to a locking box with no working lock or key slot. Secondary sources are commercial and conflict on cylinder sizes, so verify against USPS before stating specifics. Product-agent should favor cam lock replacement kits and removable options, and never claim a product is adhesive or no-drill without a source.
